title: Baasha becomes king over Israel
description: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king over all Israel in Tirzah. He reigned for twenty-four years and did what was evil in the Lord's sight, walking in the way of Jeroboam and in the sin he caused Israel to commit. [ref:1 Kings 15:33-34|1. Kongebok 15:33-34]
